newsitem.title: UK: Firms to bid for British traffic control - FT.
newsitem.headline: Firms to bid for British traffic control - FT.

text.p: The British government will announce plans on Monday to let private companies bid to operate three to five national traffic control centres, the Financial Times newspaper reported.
It said the centres would take over strategic control of traffic from police and could divert cars from busy roads, as well as provide figures on traffic flow.
Companies involved in supplying traffic management systems and those that managed road networks would be invited to bid for the programme, which would be funded by the private finance initiative.
Organisations such as the Automobile Association had already talked with the government, it added.
